title: trace-coverage-mapper-and-adaptive-burn-policy
creator: Ava Hernandez
description: Build a Trace Coverage Mapper service and integrate it with the SLO decomposition pipeline so that we can attribute SLO burn to concrete trace signatures and feed adaptive burn-rate thresholds. This ticket covers: 1) a lightweight service that consumes sampled spans + trace-enrichment metadata and produces canonical trace fingerprints mapped to SLO buckets, 2) integration with existing metrics ingestion to emit per-SLO trace-distribution histograms, and 3) heuristics for temporarily adjusting burn-rate alert thresholds based on correlated trace anomalies.
acceptance_criteria: Trace Coverage Mapper service deployed to staging and can consume x-prod-traces topic at 50% sampled traffic without backpressure
Mapper outputs canonical trace_fingerprint -> slo_id mapping, with at least 90% stability across rolling 24h window
Dashboard showing trace-fingerprint distributions per-SLO and a heatmap of top-10 contributing fingerprints
Burn-rate engine accepts trace-derived anomaly scores and defers page-once for low-signal correlated spikes (configurable policy)
Unit and integration tests covering mapping logic, edge-case of partial traces, and fallback when mapping service unavailable
implementation_steps: Design canonical trace fingerprint (span name + ordered top-3 op names + root service hash) - RFC in Confluence
Prototype mapper as streaming Flink job reading from traces topic, writing to mapper-events topic
Add mapper output consumer in metrics-ingest to emit per-slo.histogram.trace_fingerprint_count metric
Extend burn-rate-service to read trace_anomaly_score for SLO and adjust paging thresholds using sliding-window policy
Add UI widgets in console: trace-fingerprint heatmap, contributor list, and option to mute fingerprint for 1 hour
Runload test in staging with synthetic spike generator and validate no false-suppression of critical pages
technical_notes: Fingerprint algorithm trade-offs: collision risk vs. stability. Proposed stable hash using Murmur3 over normalized span path to avoid noise from IDs.
Sampling mismatch: use enrichment to link lower-sampled traces to metric spikes via request-id heuristics and prefix-KV caching metadata.
Backpressure: mapper must be able to fall back to sampling-only digest mode and emit 'mapper_unhealthy' metric for SLOs to use fallback thresholds.
Privacy: strip PII from span attributes before fingerprinting. Confluence doc lists attribute allowlist (link in links).
Performance budget: mapper must add <5ms p95 processing latency to streaming pipeline and not increase ingress cost >10%
